faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: The REST API hands-on course currently available on the platform is free. Other courses are not open yet.
faq.q2: Do I need prior coding experience?
faq.a2: The current course is a beginner-level Swagger practice. You will start by sending a GET /health request.
faq.q3: How long does it take to complete a course?
faq.a3: A specific duration has not been set for the current course, so we do not promise an unconfirmed timeframe.
faq.q5: Can I access the API Playground on mobile?
faq.a5: Course practice takes place in the Swagger web interface. A computer is recommended for the best experience.
